description: issue #200: a bare zero-argument `forward` raises `ol-not-enough-inputs` — since issue #815 `execute()` runs the checker's arity rule too, and this fixture records ITS answer; the runtime keeps its own copy for a caller driving `evaluate()`/`createEnvironment()` directly, and `check-before-execution.test.mjs` exercises that copy through the `runUnchecked` opt-out. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
